text:
maria: Quick bring-up summary for Mistral-7B across A100 vs H100 (us-west2 / eu-west1 / asia-east1). Pulled 30m steady-state runs + prefills and multi-request decode windows.

maria: Top-line (median prefill / decode in ms | toks/sec | $/1M tokens):
 - us-west2 A100: prefill 45 ms / decode 14 ms  | 12k toks/s | $28 / 1M
 - us-west2 H100: prefill 38 ms / decode 10 ms  | 16k toks/s | $21 / 1M
 - eu-west1 A100:  prefill 52 / decode 16 ms  | 10.5k toks/s | $31 / 1M
 - eu-west1 H100:  prefill 41 / decode 12 ms  | 14k toks/s | $24 / 1M
 - asia-east1 A100: prefill 65 / decode 20 ms  | 8k  toks/s | $38 / 1M
 - asia-east1 H100: prefill 50 / decode 15 ms  | 11k toks/s | $30 / 1M

maria: Observations: H100 consistently wins on decode throughput and prefill latency, especially in us-west2. A100 holds up for prefills when sequence length < 128 but drops on long decodes.

maria: Kernel split notes: flash-attention kernels on H100 gave +18-25% decode tok/s vs cuDNN path. On A100 our in-house tensorkernel (quant-aware) reclaimed ~5% over default cuDNN for q4_0 decodes.

maria: Quantization tradeoffs: q8_0 => +18-22% toks/s vs q4_0, cost down accordingly, but eval suite shows 1-2% drop on QA exact-match on narrow prompts. int8 fallback was unstable on A100 in asia-east1 (occasional decode noise).

maria: KV cache hit: chat-style workloads with 60% KV-hit saw effective decode throughput +30% (H100) because prefill overhead amortized and batching is denser. Important for sizing.

kevin: For capacity planning: if you target 1000 qps with avg request = 16 tokens, that's ~16k toks/s steady. Given above numbers that maps to:
 - us-west2 H100: single GPU ~16k toks/s median -> technically 1 GPU, but 0-20% headroom needed for p99, so recommend 2x H100 for SLA (can autoscale to 1 at low load).
 - us-west2 A100: ~12k toks/s -> need 2 GPUs to hit 16k with some headroom.
 - eu-west1 H100: 14k toks/s -> 2 GPUs for robust p99.
 - asia-east1 A100: 8k toks/s -> 3 GPUs (or 2 H100s).

sanju: Concrete recommendation for reserved capacity sizing: aim for 25-30% margin on median throughput for p99 tail control. So for 1k qps on Mistral-7B use 2 H100 in us-west2, 3 A100 in asia-east1, etc. Also use spot burst capacity for daytime peaks.

kevin: Any thermal/region caveats?

ops-bot: Note: eu-west1 H100 cluster experienced ~8% sustained throughput degradation after ~90 minutes during stress run (ambient datacenter cooling). Verified with telemetry tag: thermal-plateau-2026-03 and GPU clock drop. Ops ticket #INC-4421 opened.

maria: Good catch. We saw that in the 2hr runs as well — sustained throughput dropped ~6-9% after long bursts in eu-west1. We should add a regional derating factor for sustained burst-day plans (eu-west1 -8%, asia-east1 -10% on A100).

kevin: Can you paste the bench command so I can reproduce?

maria: Sure, minimal harness snippet we used:
```
./bench --model mistral-7b --quant q4_0 --kernel flash --region us-west2 \
  --prefill 128 --decode 256 --clients 200 --duration 1800 --log perf.json
```
(add --quant q8_0 for that sweep)

maria: Perf logging: we compute toks/s as sum(tokens_generated)/wall_seconds, and $/1M = (gpu_hour_cost * hours_used) / (total_tokens/1e6). Used cloud price table for each region.

kevin: For the $/1M numbers — did that include amortized infra (LB, control-plane) or pure GPU cost?

maria: Pure GPU + instance factor (10% infra daisy-chains). We excluded S3 and long-term storage. If you include observability retention + crosszone egress add ~+12% on top.

sanju: Any quality regressions flagged in the eval harness after q8_0 quant?

maria: Small regressions on very factual closed-book QA and arithmetic prompts, averaged 1.3% EM drop. For most chat/generative tasks it's fine. We recorded diff examples under eval-run/3743212345/ diffs.

kevin: Action items:
 - maria: push the region-derating numbers to the sizing doc and add thermal note.
 - ops: follow up on INC-4421 and attach power/ambient telemetry.
 - eng-runtime: run q8_0 safety regression sweep on 1000 eval prompts.

sanju: :thumbsup: this is super helpful — will update cost model and bump default H100 recommendation for EU to 2 GPUs for anything >500 qps.

maria: I'll upload raw perf.json and the summary CSV to the bench bucket and post link in the thread when done.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: perf.json uploaded to gs://redwood-bench/mistral7b/3743212345/perf.json

kevin: Thanks — let's sync tomorrow after q8_0 safety run.
